# Copilot instructions

This repository contains a production Blogger XML theme and a Sites visual
reference for The Bukit Besi.

- Read `AGENTS.md` before proposing changes.
- Treat `blogger/production/thebukitbesi.xml` as the production candidate.
- Never edit `blogger/backups/original-2026-07-23.xml`.
- Preserve Blogger XML namespaces, expressions, widgets and Layout editor
  behavior.
- Prefer targeted patches over full-template rewrites.
- Use vanilla JavaScript for new or migrated behavior.
- Do not add new jQuery, Bootstrap, Font Awesome, icon fonts, service workers,
  trackers, ad scripts or remote fonts.
- Do not duplicate canonical, meta description, Open Graph or JSON-LD entities.
- Ask for confirmation before changing AdSense IDs, analytics IDs, domain
  verification tags, robots behavior or deployment instructions.
- Run the repository validation and audit scripts before declaring work done.
